title: UniWind: Day-Ahead Wind Power Forecasting via Physics-Informed State Routing
abstract: arXiv:2607.01670v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurate day-ahead wind power forecasting is essential for cost-effective power-system operation. Wind power generation is primarily driven by future meteorological conditions while retaining temporal dependencies in power generation. In practice, observed wind-farm power reflects both meteorology-driven generation potential and deviations associated with local environmental and operational factors. Existing physical models provide useful constraints but adapt poorly across wind farms, whereas data-driven models can capture rich correlations but do not explicitly structure these two sources of variation. To bridge this gap, we propose UniWind, a wind power forecasting framework that integrates physics-informed generation priors with data-driven state-aware corrections. UniWind first employs a Physical Prior Estimator to construct a site-calibrated physical prior by combining a site-conditioned monotone warp with a shared physical pow

translated_title: UniWind：基于物理信息状态路由的日前风电功率预测
translated_abstract: 准确的日前风电功率预测对于电力系统的经济高效运行至关重要。风电发电主要由未来气象条件驱动，同时在发电过程中保持时间依赖性。在实际应用中，观测到的风电场功率既反映了气象驱动的发电潜力，也反映了与当地环境和运行因素相关的偏差。现有的物理模型能够提供有用的约束，但在跨风电场适应性方面表现较差；而数据驱动模型虽能捕捉丰富的相关性，却未能明确构建这两种变化来源的结构。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了UniWind，这是一个将物理信息发电先验与数据驱动的状态感知校正相结合的风电功率预测框架。UniWind首先采用物理先验估计器，通过结合场地条件化的单调变换与共享物理功率模型，构建场地校准的物理先验……
tldr: UniWind框架通过将物理信息发电先验与数据驱动的状态感知校正相结合，有效区分气象驱动的发电潜力与本地环境运行因素的影响，实现更准确的日前风电功率预测。
en_tdlr: UniWind is a day-ahead wind power forecasting framework that integrates physics-informed generation priors with data-driven state-aware corrections to explicitly structure meteorology-driven generation potential and local operational deviations.
